note: ACCIDENTALS ONLY. Box every flat / sharp / natural in the cell. INLINE accidentals (the ones standing immediately left of a notehead) are accidentalFlat/Sharp/Natural. KEY-SIGNATURE accidentals (the run at the head of a staff-start cell, between clef and meter) are keyFlat/keySharp/keyNatural — that is DSv2's own split, and the base weights were trained on it, so keep the two apart. Box each accidental of a key signature INDIVIDUALLY, not the run as one box. Do NOT box noteheads or rests in this pass; verdicts accumulate across passes. Tab out of a cell with no accidentals: that stamps `accidentals` into inspected_passes and IS the coverage record.
